name: Organic Almond Cold Brew Latte
caffeineNote: Brand states 70–78 mg per 8 oz can
summary: USDA Organic cold brew on almond milk from the Los Angeles roaster, sweetened with date paste rather than sugar: 5 g of total sugar with 0 g added, 2 g of protein and 80 calories per 8 oz can, at a brand-stated 70–78 mg of caffeine. Cashew butter is in the build too, so the can declares both almonds and cashews.
